## Location

![](images/AN08.png){width="20%" .wrap-right}


Our wedding will be at [Storey's Field Centre](https://www.storeysfieldcentre.org.uk/contact2/) in Eddington, just north of the centre of Cambridge.

The address is:
Storey's Field Centre
Eddington
Cambridge
CB3 1AA

It is around 15 minutes drive from the centre of Cambridge, 20 minutes from the train station.

There is **no parking** at the site! The nearest car park is Madingley Road Park and Ride, around 7 minutes walk from the venue.

Please bear this in mind and see [this page](parking.qmd) for more parking and travel information.

* [Travel and Parking](parking.qmd)
